title: Implement compute(a, b) arithmetic mean feature in src/main.py with helper and tests
description:
Implement a Python feature that computes the arithmetic mean of two finite numeric inputs.

Requirements:
- src/main.py must define compute(a, b) returning the arithmetic mean of two finite numeric inputs. Example: compute(2, 3) must return 2.5. Zero, negative and fractional values must be supported.
- src/helper.py must implement mean_values(a, b); src/main.py must import and use it.
- tests/test_compute.py must contain a unittest checking compute(2, 3) == 2.5.
- All three files are required.
- Validate with the public behavioral check (checks/public_check.py) and build via Python bytecode compilation of src.
